title: SceneProxy / Environment Gatherer Pattern
description: Renderer never accesses ECS registry directly. A SceneEnvironment gatherer runs per-frame to collect snapshots of all environment components (sky, lights, fog, post-process) into a flat EnvironmentState struct. Singletons use first-found semantics, arrays accumulate up to caps. Renderer reads only the gathered state. This pattern comes from UE5's SceneProxy system and decouples render thread from game thread.
whenToUse: Any time the renderer needs data from the scene/ECS. When adding new environment components (fog, clouds, post-process volumes). When implementing new render passes that need scene data.
whenNotToUse: For purely renderer-internal state (PSO cache, descriptor heaps). For editor-only data that doesn't affect rendering.
